malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: There is no legitimate use case for monkey-patching Array.prototype.filter to randomly remove elements based on the day of the week. Such behavior is not present in standard libraries or debugging tools.

Look for code that introduces random or time-based logic into built-in functions, such as Math.random() or Date-based conditions. Automated static analysis should specifically check for reassignment of built-in methods and the presence of non-deterministic logic in these reassignments.
